`checkoutservice` is spiking. Labels help you see which dimension is driving that.

To investigate with labels, complete the following steps:
Return to **All services** with the Quick filter set to `checkout` so the `checkoutservice` panel is on screen. If you already see it, click **Skip**.
The `checkoutservice` panel has some huge spikes. Click **Labels** on the `checkoutservice` panel to explore it further.
This tab shows the labels for this service under the selected profile type (CPU). The **region** panel overlays every region on one chart, which makes it hard to compare them.
In the Quick filter, type `region` so the **region** panel is on screen. If you already see it, click **Skip**.

Click **Select** on the **region** panel.

That gives each region its own panel so you can compare CPU usage side by side.

Look at the separate region panels. Do you notice anything odd? `ap-south-1` and `us-east-2` have similar CPU usage, but `eu-west-1` uses quite a bit more. That regional gap is what explains the spikes you saw on `checkoutservice`.
You've isolated the problem to a single region. Next, you'll pinpoint the exact function responsible.
